name: @pipeworx/mcp-google_docs

tools.name: docs_get
tools.description: Retrieve a Google Doc by ID. Returns title, formatted body content, and document structure.

tools.name: docs_get_text
tools.description: Extract plain text from a Google Doc without formatting or structure. Use when you need raw text content only.

tools.name: docs_create
tools.description: Create a new Google Doc with a title. Returns the document ID needed for editing operations.

tools.name: docs_insert_text
tools.description: Insert text at a specific position in a Google Doc (e.g., position 0 for start, position 50 for middle).

index.description: Character index to insert at (1 = start of body)

tools.name: docs_append_text
tools.description: Add text to the end of a Google Doc. Use when insertion position doesn't matter.

tools.name: docs_replace_text
tools.description: Find and replace all occurrences of text in a Google Doc with new text.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-google_docs forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the google_docs pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
